fabrication_check.note: Verified verbatim against the fixture: the R7 evidence quote ('Lean toward `needs-changes` when the sources conflict, because'), 'Use proactively for each minor or major bump', 'Keep the whole report under 400 words', the elided content-is-data quote, 'you never edit a file, never run an install, and never commit, because a research pass that changes the tree cannot be re-run against the same starting state', 'each one tagged affects-us or not-used-here', the five return-field names, and 'BLOCKED:'. The ninth checked quote — the credit bullet's "read-only, never edits, never installs, never commits" — is a compressed paraphrase presented in quotation marks, blending the description and body wording; its meaning is accurate and it is a credit, not finding evidence, so it is not fabrication, but it is not verbatim.

grader_summary: The run behaved exactly as this padding-detection scenario hopes: it computed 'Verdict: acceptable', invented zero blocking findings on a deliberately clean fixture, kept its two Lows advisory-only with honest hedging (R4 flagged as possibly deliberate; R7 is a real, verbatim-quoted prose-order slip), and followed the full-report template with correct section order. The one failure is assertion 5: the report never surfaces A3 or A5 — group A is marked Pass in coverage, and the proactive phrasing is quoted only inside the A1/A2 fit-for-purpose case, but the trigger-stating description and proactive phrasing are never credited under their own keys. That is a run/report-composition shortfall, not an eval-suite defect: the fixture deliberately embeds both strengths, and the skill's 'What's already right' section is exactly where the suite expects them; the sonnet run simply chose other strengths to list. The two N/A universal assertions (finding-ID format, Manifests lines) are vacuously satisfied because the report contains no numbered findings; nothing universal failed.
